mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 63 degrees.

The Verona Police Department announced the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison for the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member. Also, construction updates continue as phase two of the Aldi development begins the week of September 7 with traffic shifting on Highway M.

There is plenty to do with trivia happening today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, or live music at Paddy Mac's.
On August 30, the Verona Area School District notified police about an inappropriate relationship from 2019, leading to an arrest on September 4.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store opens today at 10:00 AM so make sure to stop by and treat yourself.
